commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Keeps your idol at full health during a solo match.

commands.name: Set souls
commands.description: Sets the saved soul balance from 0 to 999,999,999 during a solo match.

commands.name: Game speed
commands.description: Changes the speed of a solo match from 0.25× to 3× and respects pause.

commands.name: One-hit kills
commands.description: Makes damaging hits defeat solo enemies in one strike, with normal rewards.

commands.name: Unlimited special
commands.description: Keeps your idol's special active after use while this cheat is enabled.
